reviews.text: Pretty good but needs fix. This app is pretty good at preparing me for my science tests and I was able to get an A in science thanks to this app, but not so much in geometry. When I asked MathGPT some geometry questions from what I was learning, it kept getting them wrong over and over. It frustrates me so much. I understand it can’t be perfect but this is with almost every geometry question I ask. It’s really annoying. Also, in the few times where it gets the problem right, the explanations are so bad and so over complicated that it’s stressing me out but when I learn elsewhere, I realized there are much simpler ways to do the problem than what MathGPT told me. It makes the most overcomplicated explanations possible. Also, MathGPT apologizes for the mistake but keeps making the same ones it’s actually so annoying. I thought MathGPT was a good study tool and could save me in geometry but I guess I was wrong. MathGPT is only good for some things but obviously not others.
